name: What is the difference between relisting and taking the home off the market temporarily?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between relisting and taking the home off the market temporarily?

acceptedAnswer.text: Relisting means putting the property back on the active market, often with updated details and a fresh approach. Taking it off the market temporarily, or withdrawing it, removes it from public view without immediately relisting. This allows time for significant renovations or major life changes before deciding on a new sales strategy. Our agents can help you assess the best path forward based on your goals and local market trends.
acceptedAnswer.description: Relisting reactivates the sale with updates, while temporarily removing it pauses the sale for potential changes or a new strategy.
